facts.fact: The deliberation is made under law n° 18-07 of 10 June 2018 as amended and supplemented and applies its articles 3, 25, 44 and 45.
The deliberation states that the Authority has put an online complaint service at the disposal of data subjects under article 25 of law 18-07; it records no sanction or count.
The deliberation is adopted by a majority of the Authority's members at their sitting of 15 July 2026, signed by its president, with twelve members named at the foot.
